confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Belgrade price levels; no live menus, booking pages or listings were inspected. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most grounded. July accommodation rates are less certain because summer demand and events move them. Cocktail and wine_glass are set relative to the local draft beer price because direct knowledge is limited. No web lookup was used for the price anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: General knowledge of Belgrade's price level relative to other Central and Southeast European capitals such as Sofia and Bucharest (generally lower cost) and Budapest (generally higher cost). No comparable-city prices were looked up.
